find: the law partly suppresses truthful information to reduce demand, which \textit{Virginia Pharmacy} and \textit{44 Liquormart} condemn, yet leaves the information available to account holders and targets inducements to a harmful activity.
replace: the law restricts truthful information to reduce demand, yet leaves terms available to account holders and targets a subset of advertisements. Under \textit{Greater New Orleans Broadcasting Ass'n v.\ United States}, 527 U.S.\ 173 (1999), the State still needs evidence of direct advancement and a reasonable fit. The availability of in-app promotions bears on both questions.
reason: The Court's gambling-advertising decision rejected a categorical vice exception and evaluated evidence of direct advancement and fit. In-app access may matter to the tailoring inquiry and to whether the restriction materially advances the asserted goal.
